# IssetConstructsCanBeMerged

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `IssetConstructsCanBeMergedInspection`

`isset()` accepts several arguments and is true only when all of them are set.
A chain such as `isset($p) && isset($q)` is therefore the same as
`isset($p, $q)`, and `!isset($p) || !isset($q)` the same as `!isset($p, $q)`.
Merging keeps conditions short.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{3,4,5,6,7} [Before]
<?php
function probe(array $cfg, $row, $extra) {
    $r1 = isset($cfg['host']) && isset($cfg['port']);
    $r2 = isset($row->id, $row->name) && isset($extra);
    $r3 = $extra > 2 && isset($cfg['a']) && (isset($cfg['b']) && isset($cfg['c']));
    $r4 = isset($cfg['x']) && isset($cfg['y']) && ($extra || $row);
    $r5 = !isset($row->id) || !isset($row->name) || $extra;

    $n1 = isset($cfg['host']) && !isset($cfg['port']);
    $n2 = isset($cfg['host']) || isset($cfg['port']);
    $n3 = !isset($cfg['host']) && !isset($cfg['port']);
    $n4 = isset($cfg['host']) and isset($cfg['port']);
    return [$r1, $r2, $r3, $r4, $r5, $n1, $n2, $n3, $n4];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function probe(array $cfg, $row, $extra) {
    $r1 = isset($cfg['host'], $cfg['port']);
    $r2 = isset($row->id, $row->name, $extra);
    $r3 = $extra > 2 && isset($cfg['a'], $cfg['b']) && isset($cfg['c']);
    $r4 = isset($cfg['x'], $cfg['y']) && ($extra || $row);
    $r5 = !isset($row->id, $row->name) || $extra;

    $n1 = isset($cfg['host']) && !isset($cfg['port']);
    $n2 = isset($cfg['host']) || isset($cfg['port']);
    $n3 = !isset($cfg['host']) && !isset($cfg['port']);
    $n4 = isset($cfg['host']) and isset($cfg['port']);
    return [$r1, $r2, $r3, $r4, $r5, $n1, $n2, $n3, $n4];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 3: Merge this check into the preceding isset() call.</li>
<li>line 4: Merge this check into the preceding isset() call.</li>
<li>line 5: Merge this check into the preceding isset() call.</li>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "IssetConstructsCanBeMerged": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore IssetConstructsCanBeMerged

/**
 * @noinspection IssetConstructsCanBeMergedInspection
 */
```
